description:
Safe to add mid-game

Save compatible with 2.0

Breaks saves if removed

No known mod conflicts

Requires LunaLib | Requires LazyLib
Dependencies are automatically downloaded when installing with TriOS
Integrated with Version Checker | Supports Unknown Skies planet types
Older versions and changelogs

Description

Short Summary
Adds images to all vanilla planets, a way to change them, and 1300+ AI-generated illustrations to choose from for your own colonies.
Change planet and colony descriptions with an in-game interface.

Long Summary
This mod contains around 1300 AI-generated illustrations for colonies that have been manually sorted and edited.
It adds pre-specified images to all vanilla planets and can add fitting images to modded and newly established colonies.
In random mode, the algorithm tries to pick matching illustrations for each planet depending on planet type, conditions, size, population, faction and some other factors.
You can change and adjust the description of any planets you own, adding or removing text as you like, for better roleplaying and immersion.

The mod is customizable through LunaSettings.

VRAM-Impact is low thanks to a custom image loader - the mod only loads images in systems you visit, and unloads them when you leave.
Note that VRAM-Estimators will grossly overestimate the memory use of this mod as they do not account for the custom loader.

Text changing Functionality
Your colony texts are boring!

You click the change button and write a better description!

Click save, and your colony texts are no longer boring!

Image changing Functionality
You establish a colony, and the mod automatically picks a fitting image!

If you don't like it, just click the change button, pick your tags, preview and choose!

You can apply any image to any planet, no holds barred.
Duplicates are disabled by default for immersion, but can be displayed with a simple click.

Your new image will greet you every time you dock - until you decide to change it again.

Image Examples

FAQ
Can I add images to my planets?
Yup, that's what this mod is for.

Can I change the images on NPC planets?
Yes - either change the setting in Illustrated.Entities/data/config/settings.json, or just enable devmode (remember to turn it off afterwards!).

Does it add images to my existing colonies?
Yes, on game start. If a colony doesn't have an image, just save and reload, if it still doesn't have one, report it here.

It doesn't apply images to modded colonies, why?!?
Mod authors have their own vision of a planet, and my algorithm is not infallible (it tries, but it's probably a gamma core. Don't discriminate.). Feel free to enable the setting to apply random images, but don't be disappointed if the results don't match up.

Can I add my own images?
Sure! It's probably easiest to just replace an existing one, but if you want to make the effort, just add the image in the correct 480x300px, RGB-8, .png format in the mod folder, and add the line in image_data.csv. Add at least one "required" tag so the image shows up, and presto!

The images you picked for vanilla suck!
You can always switch that image by editing image_data.csv, it's easy! I'm also always open to suggestions - just post the planet and the image number here, and I'll give it a look.

How many images did you sort through?
Around 6500.

Those tags are weird.
You are weird.

Did you really spend two months of your free time doing this?
Look, man. You spend your time playing League of Legends, I spend mine sperging over .csv files. We are probably on the same autism level.

Are you okay?
I dream of Midjourney, and the machine mind probably dreams of me. At least I hope it does, since my eyes ran away. Not that they ever existed, except for that time they did. Ask Tim for his shizo meds he forgot to take them again and might sell them to you.

Change Log
Changelogs 2.0.a + can be found here.

1.2.b Adjusted - 0.97 compatibility

1.2.a Added - setting specifying if the pre-set images overwrite the existing vanilla illustrations. off by default.
Adjusted - 0.96 compatibility
Fixed - Crash when abandoning a colony
Fixed - Custom set images are no longer lost on save reload
Fixed - Orbital Stations no longer have different visuals than planets until player leaves system
Fixed - Custom images now get retained when set via orbital station
Fixed - Custom images now immediately apply to orbital stations when leaving a planet

1.1.a General
Added - In-game overlay allowing you to change planet and colony descriptions and texts
Added - Setting to set the "Display duplicates" button to true by default
Fixed - Should now consistently apply illustrations to player owned planets without image
Fixed - Removed signature from image 12
Fixed - Added !cld tag to image 3

discordPostHtml:
Change your colony descriptions and illustrations.

Adds images to all vanilla planets, a way to change them, 1300+ AI-generated illustrations to choose from for your own colonies, and allows you to edit and add descriptions to your own planets with an in-game UI.

VRAM-Impact is around 70 mb during normal gameplay because the mod only loads images that you look at and unloads them when you are done.

Changelog:
2.0.c - More crash fixes!
2.0.b - Fixed a crash
2.0.a - Absolutely massive update with 1300 new images
Removed all old trash AIslop images
The mod now actively unloads what you don't need = almost no VRAM use
+ Save Compatible with 2.0.
+ Can be installed on an ongoing save
This means: The mod can be added if it was not present on game start, but can not be updated during an ongoing game if you started the save with an older version than 2.0!
